exposure: UAE with hysteroscopy plus laparoscopy group
uterine artery embolization (UAE) plus hysteroscopy group
cohort: 211 patients with cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP) admitted to Sichuan Provincial People's Hospital from March 2016 to February 2018.
finding: Hysteroscopy is a safe and effective treatment for CSP in patients at less than or equal to eight weeks of gestation and with a gestational sac diameter less than or equal to 3.0 cm.
